observed_result: fetch failed; github.com ENOTFOUND; no dist/electron.exe

hypothesis: The npm registry tarball (reachable) may vendor the win32-x64 runtime or a compatible package may.

hypothesis: The earlier ENOTFOUND was a transient resolver failure, not a policy block; a plain retry will resolve and download.
action: Resolve-DnsName for registry.npmjs.org, api.deepseek.com, github.com, api.github.com, objects.githubusercontent.com, raw.githubusercontent.com; HEAD requests to github.com, api.github.com, the v45.3.0 SHASUMS256.txt asset; node node_modules/electron/install.js
observed_result: All six names resolved (github.com 140.82.113.4, objects.githubusercontent.com 185.199.110.133); HTTPS 200 from github.com and api.github.com; release asset HTTP 200 (6740 bytes); installer exited 0 and created node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe; window smoke then passed including live navigation and popup refusal.
notes: Counter closed by evidence, not reset: the three earlier no-progress attempts remain in this ledger. No firewall, proxy, hosts-file, DNS, or registry setting was changed.

hypothesis: The 404 MB aggregate hides which process holds the memory; if it is Chromium baseline rather than Mona data structures, no application fix can reach the target.
action: Built a probe (apps/desktop/src/main/memory-probe.ts) that keeps the P22 metric and adds per-process working set and private bytes plus the renderer JS heap after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage; reproduced the P22 workload (20000 rows, 500 rendered, 60 s idle) on the development build.
observed_result: 404.0-404.4 MB reproduced, so the basis is sound. Browser 113.9 MB with a 12.0 MB JS heap; Tab 103.8 MB with a 3.4 MB JS heap and 9382 DOM nodes; GPU 102.6 MB; utility 51.1 MB. JavaScript heap is ~4% of the footprint.
progress_reason: Localized the cost to rendered DOM rows and Chromium process baseline instead of Mona data retention.

hypothesis: 500 rendered timeline rows cost tens of MB of working set, so windowing the rendered rows reduces the footprint without touching data.
action: Measured the cost of expanding the live DOM from 120 to 500 rendered items (+27.7 MB); shipped a 120-row render window with a keyboard-reachable "show earlier" control; re-measured the installed candidate with the same workload and idle interval.
observed_result: Installed candidate dropped from 404 MB to 371.4 MB (11 samples, 60 s); renderer DOM nodes 9382 -> 2497; JS heap 5.8 -> 3.4 MB; startup unaffected (cold 422 ms, warm 738 ms). Target still unmet by 21.4 MB.
progress_reason: -32.6 MB measured on the installed candidate with functionality preserved; remaining cost is Chromium baseline and host software compositing.
